scope: Tool results and frozen source only; no answer grading or hidden thinking analysis.

definitions.tool_round: Unique assistant message.id with at least one tool_use, not SDK turns.
definitions.evidence_bundle: The first curated evidence set per criterion is used as a conservative full-line coverage diagnostic. Alternate/partial evidence can support a correct answer; absence here does not fail its score.
definitions.volume: Unicode code points in tool_result text, excludes JSON metadata, assistant text and hidden thinking. Not tokens/cost.

tool_return_volume.definition: Sum Unicode code points / UTF-8 bytes of user message tool_result content text only; excludes duplicate root tool_use_result payload, JSON framing, assistant text, hidden thinking and usage tokens.

read_overlap.definition: Exact frozen-source (path,line) pairs in Read results; repeat means same source line returned by a subsequent Read, not repeated reasoning or intention.

all_tools_source_overlap.note: Includes Grep-to-Read and search-preview-to-Read overlap, often useful navigation or contextual follow-up; not automatically waste.
